hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?

hey there - i was just thinking about your background and what you're looking for next

what's the dream role you've been thinking about?
My name is Tshiteej, I’m looking for a senior back end developer role in a remote setup

tshiteej... that's a name with character. senior backend dev going remote - smart move, the whole "commute to write code" thing never made sense anyway.

where you working these days?

aquera... the fintech play building payment rails for emerging markets. solid space to be in.

found you on linkedin - tshiteej bhardwaj, senior full stack developer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/tshiteej

ah my bad - different aquera then. 

found tshiteej bhardwaj, senior full stack developer. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/tshiteej

senior full stack at aquera... building across the entire stack but your heart's with backend. i get it - frontend can be a special kind of chaos. what made you want to focus more on the backend side?
